overall.verdict: The mobile-light variant demonstrates strong execution of the xln wallet's core value proposition with excellent visceral value bars, clear data hierarchy, and good trust cues. The design successfully implements the one-scale bar principle and provides provable transaction receipts. However, there are inconsistencies in color usage, some visual noise elements, and occasional technical language that could be simplified for better user understanding.
priority_fixes: Standardize color palette across all screens (use indigo #6E7CFF instead of purple for primary actions)
Reduce visual noise by removing redundant elements (legends, 'empty hidden' text, overly prominent technical terms)
Improve mobile-specific touch targets and button sizing throughout the app
Simplify technical language in settings and receipts for better user comprehension
Enhance visual hierarchy in transaction lists and activity screens
